notes.title: Bugfixes 1.0
notes.content:
Fixed bugs that players wrote about in "negative" reviews and added some changes for convenience.

Fixed:
Fixed bug with getting stuck near a jug.
Fixed bug with falling under textures.
Fixed bug with passing behind a fence, from where it is impossible to get out.

Added:
Added additional tips to some places.
